EmailTemplate.subject: Flywire is here to help!
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
The Flywire Client Success Team is here to support you and your students.
As your busy payment season approaches, we wanted to reach out to provide you with some helpful resources.
Flywire Dashboard You can easily navigate and manage your payments from the new and improved Flywire Dashboard <[[http://dashboard.flywire.com/?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]>. From the dashboard, you can track and view payment details, download student resources, export reports and send bulk refunds.
Please see this brief walk-through of the payment function. Learn how to search, track, and easily manage your payments!
- [VIDEO] How to Manage Payments <[[https://youtu.be/zHiynO0lqJ4]]>
Need to refund a full or partial payment or even multiple payments at once? We made it easy for you!
- Refund Virtual Resources Hub <[[https://www.flywire.com/industries/education/refunds-virtual-resources-hub?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]>
Payer Communication We know the upcoming semester plans are constantly changing and your institution will likely not host an in-person orientation. Instead, share one of our quick Virtual Orientation 2020 videos with students and parents to show how Flywire works.
- Virtual Orientation [English] <[[https://vimeo.com/432625880]]>
- Virtual Orientation [Chinese] <[[https://vimeo.com/433652096]]>
Need further assistance? Visit our Help Center <[[https://help.client.flywire.com/?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]> at any time or contact the Global Client Success Team with any questions or concerns at clientsuccess@flywire.com <[[mailto:clientsuccess@flywire.com]]>.
Thank you for working with us!
